Game Overview

Espada de Sheris is a adventure game built around guide Kibo, the European ninja cat, through a post-apocalyptic world, mastering parkour in a thrilling 2D platformer. Hone your agility and wield the Espada de Sheris to outsmart masked adversaries and uncover the secrets of a futuristic alien realm. Engage in dynamic, evolving adventures chapter by chapter.
